title: Saddam Stole $1 Billion From His Own Bank — Then Soldiers Stole It Back
description:
On March 18, 2003 — one day before American bombs fell on Baghdad — Saddam Hussein sent his son Qusay to Iraq's Central Bank with a signed order to withdraw nearly $1 billion in cash. Shrink-wrapped bricks of U.S. dollars and euros were loaded onto flatbed trucks and driven into the night.

After Baghdad fell, U.S. troops raided Saddam's palaces and recovered $782 million hidden in huts and walls. But then soldiers from the very unit that found the cash started smuggling bricks home. One sergeant shipped $600,000 to his wife; another buried bundles in his backyard.

Roughly $138 million has never been found. No trace. No paper trail. Just gone.
